notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE UNDERWAY!
notes.content:
I am currently working on a complete overhaul of Age of Omens, using the most current version of Unreal engine 4, and might possibly be moving to 5.1 in the future in a few key things are fixed in time. 

To follow the progress and see what's coming down the line for this game, check out the youtube channel 

[previewyoutube=6VzKVmC1X3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:

1. New blood damage screen FX.
2. AI Skelly warrior initial set up. 
3. AI Skelly Archer initail setup.
4. Particle effects added to footsteps.
5. Removed double tap to roll (needs fixes).

7. Added General Store Catalogue and General store.  You can now purchase goods for gold. 
8. Gold ore x2 now smeltable into gold nuggets via your furnace.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.7.3 (NEW AFFLICTED, NOW CAN BE STEALTH KILLED!)
notes.content:
1.7.3

1. Slow/Fast zombies re-created, (needs 1 more pass) CAN NOW BE STEALTH KILLED W/ A DAGGER
2. Decor added to Necromancer's tower.  (A glimpse of items to come perhaps?)
3. AI pathing optimizations.  AI now create their own nav mesh instead of existing in one large one.
4. Ent now have proper boulder throw attacks, and have been placed in the world. 

This was a small update but I wanted to get it out because the next patch will be BIG, and will take some time
to get ready.  I'm adding a whole new tier of weapons/armor/and items, including magic and health potions
and the ingredients needed to make them, along with smoothing out some of the rough AI behaviour, finishing 
the first raid keep, and a long list of other improvements.  I have the game mapped out from now until finish,
and I think you guys are really going to enjoy the way I plan to blend the story with survival/town building 
elements I have planned.  This will not be your typical survival game, but in a good way I hope!!! Stay tuned! 

Also (almost forgot) .. I have left you all a few suprises in the Necro's tower in case you want to play around
with some of the spells, along with a glider that will all be removed from the starting area next update. 

Feel free to report any bugs with these items so I can get them ready to add in to the crafting/drop lists!

Thanks everyone, and happy hunting!

notes.title: AGE OF OMENS SUMMER SALE!
notes.content:
Several people from the community have asked how best to support the development of Age of Omens, so I have created a discounted price for those who wish to contribute.

[previewyoutube=I3ih32rjBM8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Until May 26th, Age of Omens is ON SALE!  If you have been interested in supporting this game, by purchasing during this short sale, it will greatly help me to work full time on bringing new quests, monsters, items and mechanics to the game in a speedy fashion!

If you are just now finding the game and interested in trying it out first for FREE, please join the discord

https://discord.gg/9anR6ydX

where you can still download the current version of the game FOR FREE.  

This test version of the game won't be updated for much longer, but is currently the same version of the game on Steam, so there is NO RISK to try my game out fist to make sure it runs nicely on your computer before purchasing. 

PLEASE understand that the game is not finished, and still in a very early state.  Work is being completed on it daily, and as such, there are often resets, and wipes at this stage.  Feel free to check out the game for free and ONLY purchase if you are sure you would like to contribute to helping me build my dream of a fully independent game studio who creates memorable experience through game design, with our players (NOT SHAREHOLDERS) as our number one focus.  

I am one person, supported by my awesome youtube and discord community, so every like, sub, shoutout, click, or just  your general interest in my game really helps to inspire the work.  

To those who have helped me along this far with everything from testing, feedback, advice, steam purchases, wishlists, THANK YOU, sincerely, THANK YOU.  

Game on!

Crow ːknightː

notes.title: Another day, another HUGE update! Archery overhaul! Behold the mighty longbow!
notes.content:
1.1.9 "A hunter's longbow arrives in Hy Brasil."

Behold, the mighty bow of the hunter.  The longbow!  
Twice the effective range of the stick bow, and soon to get a new release mechanic, the Longbow is not only more accurate but also packs twice the power of the stick bow!

Bow ballistics added with true physics drop.  Bows on target of crosshair now.  Basic bow drops faster, and longbow is more accurate with better initial velocity and range before dropping. 


All creature hitboxes adjusted for accuracy of body size.  
Frogs physics bodies fixed (easier to hit when on target now)


New items added!

Eggs (cook 3x in campfire for fried egg meal!)
Sinew - dropped by wolves, bears, deer.
Feathers - Dropped by chickens only (so far)
Longbow - Crafted in the crafting bench. (50 dmg)
Longbow arrows - crafted in the crafting bench. 

Torch now lights when equipped.

Animal sounds galore!
Deer adjusted to have more health (50) and better detection range due to longbow being added.
Fixed loot bags. 
Loot bag effects added to certain creatures. 

UI improvements & adjustments. 
:knight:

notes.title: 1.1.8 "The trees are watching me."
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34783590/3cbd34273cc73109a92acfc27c1b0e4ce4c41d0a.jpg

The trees have begun to grow angry at the magical disturbance in the north.  While they do mean to protect their wooded realm, they do not discriminate as to which humans they will smash with a hefty foot of roots.  Be wary of their ability to hide themselves by standing perfect still, for when angered, they become quite fast and agile, for being a giant walking plant that is.. Also, the simple bow and arrow will have no effect on these giants, fire and blade is what they fear.  

Occasionally one might find a piece or two of the magical yew wood used for creating wands and staffs with special arcane abilities.  Good hunting friends! 

---------------------------------------------------------------

Fixed bow not doing dmg after optimizing AI creatures.
Crab, frog, chicken no longer drop hide.
Hide drops increased for bear, deer, wolf,
Item added "Flax Twine" Crafted with flax and animal fat. 
Simple bow now crafted with flax twine and 3 sticks. 
New loot drop models with effects. 
Gore added to certain weapon strikes and kills. 
Loot drops fixed for all creatures. 
flax and lavender now hold 1 resource each. 
AI optimized and added further customization options for the future. 

As always, thanks for your patience while I fix bugs and add more content. 

New map expansion coming next week! More creatures, more items, more loot, and rare world drop will begin dropping once the map is expanded.  

Stay tuned on discord for all the latest info!
